name: Tomás Vargas
bio:
Tomás's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with go-karts in his hometown of Santiago. His meticulous nature and keen understanding of vehicle dynamics quickly set him apart. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, Tomás interned with a local rally team, where he honed his skills in data analysis and driver communication. He joined ROWE Racing two years ago, initially as a junior data analyst, but his ability to identify crucial performance gains during test sessions earned him a promotion to Test Driver Coordinator.

In his current role, Tomás is responsible for planning and executing all test programs, ensuring that drivers and engineers are aligned in their objectives. He possesses a rare talent for synthesizing complex data into actionable insights, enabling drivers to push the limits of their cars while maintaining safety. Tomás's visionary approach to problem-solving, combined with his collaborative spirit, makes him a valuable asset to the team. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor and his ability to bring clarity to stressful situations. He aims to revolutionize test programs by applying innovative technologies, making them highly efficient and extremely effective.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight wave
physical.description: Tomás has a focused and intense gaze that reflects his passion for motorsport.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten data observations
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought
Insists on calibrating all testing equipment himself, no matter how trivial
